country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Shield House Gloucester data centre refurbishment
developer: Shield House / local data centre operator
notes: DCD reported a project to convert the 20,000 sq ft Shield House server farm in Barnwood, Gloucester into a modern data centre with 1.5MW customer power, planned to open in Q1 2017.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Equinix London data centre campuses
notes: Equinix lists ten London data centre campuses serving colocation/interconnection, AI-ready workloads and cloud access. Public page does not disclose aggregate MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Digital Realty London colocation campuses
notes: Digital Realty describes itself as the largest provider of data centre space and services in London, with six interconnected London campuses. Capacity by campus not disclosed on the public page.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Serverfarm LON1 Feltham data centre
notes: Serverfarm acquired the Feltham/London data centre in March 2018 through sale and partial leaseback; public materials describe 130,000 sq ft and 10.5MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Vantage London I and London II campuses
notes: Vantage states LHR1 will provide 55MW and LHR2 20MW; company announcement says LHR2 in Park Royal was due to open at end-September 2025.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Colt DCS Hayes Digital Park / London 4 expansion
notes: Colt public page lists London 4 as under construction; DCD/PRNewswire report the initial Hayes campus as two buildings totaling 60MW IT power, with phase one targeted for Q3 2025.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Ark Data Centres Union Park Hayes campus
notes: Ark lists Union Park in Hayes as an AI-ready data centre campus with 99MW total compute capacity and phase-four public materials describe a four-block facility with associated energy centres.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pulsant Fareham SE-5 data centre
notes: Pulsant acquired SCC's Fareham facility; public Pulsant page describes the south coast site between Portsmouth and Southampton, while Ocolo lists 3MW/84,820 sq ft.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: ServerHouse Brunel Way Fareham data centre
notes: ServerHouse describes its Brunel Way/Fareham Tier III purpose-built data centre near M27 Junction 9 with 22,000 sq ft and racks from 3-20kW; public page does not disclose aggregate MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Aptum Portsmouth/Havant data centre
notes: Aptum markets a Portsmouth Data Centre in Havant/Langstone Technology Park; third-party listings describe the former IBM hard-drive factory facility with up to 1,000 cabinets and 10MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Hartlepool-Darlington AI Growth Zone data centre proposal
developer: Hellens Group partnership / unnamed national data centre operator / investment firm
notes: Public reporting says Hartlepool and Darlington submitted an AI Growth Zone bid focused on two data-centre sites with over 450MVA secured power. MW IT capacity, final sites and approval status are not public.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Wyenet Herefordshire server housing facility
notes: Wyenet publicly offers server co-location/housing at a Herefordshire facility with secure, air-conditioned space, UPS protected power and monitored environment. Small enterprise facility; no MW disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Google Waltham Cross data centre
notes: Google announced opening of its Waltham Cross, Hertfordshire data centre on 2025-09-16 as part of a two-year GBP5bn UK investment; public sources do not disclose MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Equinix Hertfordshire Campus / former DC01UK South Mimms
notes: Equinix bought the under-construction DC01UK campus near South Mimms and announced a GBP3.9bn investment; public reports and Equinix social post describe 250MW+ compute capacity on an 85-acre site.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Greystoke Abbots Langley data centre
notes: Secretary of State allowed appeal and granted planning permission for Greystoke's Bedmond Road, Abbots Langley hyperscale data centre; specialist legal/planning sources describe 84,000 sq m and up to 96MW capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: St Mary's Hospital Isle of Wight data centre upgrade
developer: Secure I.T. Environments for St Mary's Hospital / NHS Isle of Wight
notes: DCD reported Secure I.T. Environments completed a mechanical and electrical upgrade at St Mary's Hospital's Isle of Wight data centre, bringing capacity to 80kW. This is a public-sector/healthcare facility, not commercial colocation.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Clearstone/CSE52 Ebbsfleet AI Data Centre Campus, New Barn Road Dartford
notes: Clearstone announced a 300MW AI data centre campus near Dartford/Ebbsfleet; MHCLG Section 35 direction states up to four buildings, total power load up to 300MW and IT load up to 240MW, requiring development consent.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: The Bunker Kent data centre, Sandwich
notes: Colo-X lists The Bunker at Ash Radar Station, Marshborough Road, Sandwich, Kent as an ultra-secure operational data centre in a former MOD bunker; no MW disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Custodian/Beaming Maidstone data centre colocation
notes: Beaming markets Kent colocation hosted at Custodian's Maidstone data centre; third-party listings also identify Maidstone/Kent Science Park data centre locations. No MW disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Lindley Moor Data Centre Campus proposal
notes: Kirklees planning history records 2009/92550 outline data campus refused, followed by 2011/91518 outline application for a Data Centre Campus with access off Lindley Moor Road approved subject to Section 106. Later planning documents suggest the site was involved in subsequent mixed industrial/residential proposals; build-out status unclear.
